segments.name: Beauty retail
segments.description: Operates specialty retail stores, e-commerce, and salon services selling beauty and wellness products to beauty enthusiasts.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, which includes retail stores, salon services, and e-commerce.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay the company for merchandise sold in stores and online, salon services, and gift cards, plus credit card program fees, loyalty deferrals, and royalties.
revenueModel.evidence: We recognize merchandise revenue at the point of sale in our retail stores. E-commerce sales are recognized upon shipment or guest pickup of the merchandise based on meeting the transfer of control criteria.
